description:
'''Milwaukee hip-hop''' is a subgenre of [[Midwestern hip-hop]] that is specific to [[Milwaukee|Milwaukee, Wisconsin]], with its cultural influence spreading [[United States|nationally]] and throughout the [[Midwestern United States|Midwest]]. The identifying style of the sound includes clapping rhythms and heavy bass, which came to rise in the 2010s and 2020s. 

Before the modern sound identity of Milwaukee emerged, there has been a strong legacy going back to the 1980s and 90s, with artists such as The Majestics, Rusty Pelicans, A-tack, and [[Coo Coo Cal]]. In the 2010s, the rise of the modern sound began with artists such as Chicken P, and was further propelled in the 2020s by the likes of [[Certified Trapper]], [[J.P. (rapper)|J.P.]], and the ''Run Along Forever'' record label.

In contrast with the larger Midwest hip-hop genre and the neighboring [[Michigan rap|Detroit rap scene]], Milwaukee hip-hop has a much rowdier, more eccentric, and experimental sound. Sonically, it is evocative and of the [[Drill music|drill]] and [[Trap music|trap]] genres. In its recent innovations, including its presence on [[TikTok]] and [[Instagram]], Milwaukee hip-hop has adopted a more brash and humorous style.
